Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Texture Throw Pillow - 18 x 18 Inch, Grey
Colors: Gray
The light gray field of this beautiful modern throw pillow is studded with sequin-like circles of white yarn that form a stylish asymmetrical chevron pattern that meets in the middle to create an “X” shape. Cotton/polyester Imported 18"L x 18"W The zipper on this pillow is placed on the back. It has a machine-woven base with added texture and a luxe handfeel. 1 throw pillow Spot clean with a damp cloth, and then allow to air dry. Rather than pulling at any loose threads, please use scissors to trim them.
